integer_validity_theorem: For an Original integer unit, C>0 implies one connected STAY arc and binary charge_mode=1. Hence D=0 and every departure travel debit T=0. The retained energy equality then gives E_next=E+alpha*C<=Emax. If C=0, E+alpha*C<=Emax is the original SOC box. For beta*D+T<=E-Emin: C=0 uses E_next=E-beta*D-T>=Emin; C>0 gives D=T=0 and uses E>=Emin. No route, mode, power, travel or terminal SOC restriction is added to the Original integer domain; the retained continuous LP can be strengthened.

original_source_authority.proof: Nonnegative binary unit flow on a strict time DAG with one source and one terminal is a single complete path. At most one site STAY is connected at a slot. Literal retained P connection/mode rows then prove the aggregate mode hull for every Original S1 integer point.
